reviews.text:
My cat wasn't feeling well, and my usual vet was closed, so I came here. I called 10 minutes before closing time, but when I explained the situation, they told me to come right away.

It turned out my cat had urinary stones, and they performed a catheterization on the spot. Thank you so much.
I feel at ease entrusting my child to the vet because they are a cat lover. ☺️
I've been going there for a long time.
This teacher is very caring and attentive. I look forward to continuing to work with them.
I am always grateful for your care. You always provide thorough and careful examinations, which gives me peace of mind. You are also considerate of the feelings of both the owner and the pet.

Thank you for your continued support!

The doctor is very kind and attentive.

My dog ​​loves the doctor too.
